_comment: Erasure classification (docs/legal/ERASURE_PLAN.md). Every public table that carries a member column (user_id, profile_id, member_id) or a reference column (owner_id, author_id, actor_id, created_by, sender_id, recipient_id, granted_by) must be listed. action: delete | anonymise | retain | pending_decision. reviewed=false means a human has not confirmed the row. scripts/erasure-policy-contract.py enforces completeness in CI; --gate must pass before erasure_worker_enabled is ever set to true.
